items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: the late Martin Luther King got killed

ctx.x: Yes. We was so lucky, because when that album start to, they start o spread out for the exhibition, the late Martin Luther King got killed and as mentioned, "Machito comes from Memphis", nobody want to know about Memphis. The people they was so ashamed. They lose a great guy like Martin Luther King, that he mean so well, that both groups they don't want to hear about Memphis, really. So now "Machito goes Memphis" so it wasn't called for for that particular time.
Uh-huh, but yet most of these albums finally went to other countries and they become best sellers there.
